scope.responsibility: Repaint captured material and work-draft summaries in the selected language without reading or changing operational state
inventory: C06 material and modern work-draft summary producers

before.failure: Switching the actual selector from Portuguese to English changed review headings while material draft, work draft and old-alert warning stayed Portuguese. Browser assertion failed on the captured English material summary.

implementation.producerContract: An optional non-enumerable, non-writable reviewText property contains a frozen map of five strings rendered from the same captured values. Enumerated keys and JSON stay exactly kind/text. The existing text string still uses the current language.
implementation.consumer: Copies the complete five-string presentation map once into a private binding. Repaint only selects a captured string. No callback, provider read, storage read, write or operational network request is used to change language. Incomplete/invalid opt-in maps and legacy plain items retain their literal text.
implementation.coverage: Material drafts, pending/blocked requests, unsaved-copy branch and legacy warnings; modern work drafts and pending/error/external-state warnings. Formatting helpers now pass the selected language through nested owned descriptors and store-message formatting. Existing catalogues, payloads, queue logic, persistence and session guards remain intact.

newBrowserAssertions: Real material/work draft summaries and old-alert warning update through the actual picker in five languages at320/390/1440px; silent preference also repaints.
Nodes, focus, original review/route stamp, raw drafts, account, full queued records, UUID, payload, digest and blocked failure are unchanged.
Producer call counts and all operational request counts are unchanged during language cycles.
Public enumerable and JSON shape unchanged; captured five-language map frozen and property non-writable/non-enumerable.
Literal pool name containing markup and translation-key syntax remains text; incomplete opt-in map falls back to literal text.
Actual failed stock request produces a blocked queue row; real storage quota failure preserves the old draft and adds the unsaved-work warning.
A held producer response captured in Portuguese renders in the current language after release, while button and aria-busy stay occupied.
Token change while the producer is held refuses its captured rows; restored session reviews safely again.
Offline reload rebuilds translations from the same saved drafts/queue and current service-worker cache; zero page errors or markup execution.
